leftEvidence.title: Ransom and redemption language addresses death and Sheol amid judgment

points.label: Quoted language
points.left: Death and Sheol are addressed with questions about plague and destruction.
points.right: Death is addressed after mortality becomes immortality, followed by a question about sting.

points.label: Immediate setting
points.left: The words stand beside Ephraim’s guilt, delayed birth, and withheld compassion.
points.right: The words stand beside trumpet, transformation, victory through Jesus, and steadfast labor.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Transformation and victory reuse death’s taunt before thanksgiving and work

payload.tension: The later taunt reuses Hosea’s death-language while the oracle’s judgment setting and Paul’s transformation argument remain separately inspectable.
payload.title: Ransom from death / death swallowed in victory
